BiblicalUsage: Machir is two men in one name, and the verses keep them apart. The first is Machir the son of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, named in 1 Chronicles 7:14 and Joshua 17:1, where he is called the firstborn of Manasseh and a man of war. The second is Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, named in 2 Samuel 9:4, in whose house Mephibosheth was sheltering when David sent for him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Machirs show both sides of the name: one took land by war, and the other kept a crippled prince alive in his house.
RelatedPeople: King David; Joseph, Son of Jacob
